name: Dynamics
description: Particularly relevant for Mechanical, Aerospace and Robotics engineers, this course focuses on the dynamics of mechanical systems. Topics include kinematics, force-momentum formulation for systems of particles and rigid bodies, work-energy concepts, virtual displacements and virtual work, Lagrange's equations, linearization of equations of motion, linear stability analysis, and free and forced vibration of linear multi-degree-of-freedom models. Emphasis is on connecting these topics to realistic engineering problems via hands-on and numerical design projects.
